infotexts.entitydescription.Cells_BoneThresher: A tissue sample from a Bone Thresher; could be used to replicate their extraordinary jaws.
infotexts.entitydescription.Cells_Charybdis: A tissue sample from a formidable Charybdis; the key to replicating their intensely powerful jaws - but at what cost?
infotexts.entitydescription.Cells_Endworm: A tissue sample from an Endworm. The shell feels nearly impenetrable.
infotexts.entitydescription.Cells_Hammerhead: A tissue sample from a Hammerhead. Irregularly tough to protect Hammerheads from trauma.
infotexts.entitydescription.Cells_Moloch: A tissue sample from the tough shell of a Moloch used to protect its head. Required to develop and patch their shells.
infotexts.entitydescription.Cells_Mudraptor: A tissue sample from the tough shell of a Mudraptor used to protect itself.
infotexts.entitydescription.Cells_TigerThresher: A tissue sample from a tiger thresher. Could be used to replicate their powerful jaws.
infotexts.entitydescription.Cells_Broodmother: A tissue sample from a broodmother. Could be cultured into organs.
